title: Majlis real-time and AI contracts
description: Shared by the .NET backend, the Angular and Flutter clients and ai-service. Source of truth for the shapes in docs/architecture/realtime-collaboration.md §4. JSON property names are camelCase.

sessionEvent.description: Durable timeline event. Hub method 'sessionEvent' and POST /api/rooms/sessions/events|getbyid. Apply strictly by seq.

data.description: Per type: control.changed {kind: start|claim|request-accepted|handoff|takeover|release|timeout, from, to, epoch, note}; turn.started {instruction, language, instructedBy}; turn.completed {text, citations[], usage}; turn.stopped {partialText}; turn.failed {reasonKey, partialText?}; control.requested {requestId, userId, displayName}; control.request.resolved {requestId, userId, accepted}; handoff.offered {to, note}; handoff.resolved {userId, accepted}.

streamMessage.description: Stream lane. ai-service PUBLISHes it (JSON) to Redis channel majlis:session:{sessionId}:stream; clients receive it as hub method 'streamEvent'. Not stored; ordered by (turnId, chunk).

data.description: turn.delta {text: appended text}; turn.progress {key: localization key, params: {}} e.g. Ai:Progress:Searching {count: 3}.

presenceSnapshot.description: Hub method 'presence' and the JoinSession result.

startAiTurnRequest.description: Rooms → ai-service: POST /internal/sessions/{sessionId}/turns (internal network only) with the driver's Authorization header. ai-service answers 202 and runs the turn in the background.

history.description: Up to 6 previous completed turns, oldest first.

turnCompleted.description: ai-service → Rooms over RabbitMQ: plain JSON body, published to the durable fanout exchange majlis.turn-completed with AMQP type = turn-completed (ADR-0009). Handlers are idempotent on turnId.

turnStopped.description: ai-service → Rooms (exchange majlis.turn-stopped, type turn-stopped) after it saw majlis:turn:{turnId}:cancel or a TurnStopRequested message.

x-redis-keys.majlis:turn:{turnId}:text: hash {text, chunk}: the running text, for late joiners (TTL 10 min)
x-redis-keys.majlis:turn:{turnId}:cancel: set by Rooms on stop; ai-service checks it between deltas
x-redis-keys.majlis:turn:{turnId}:hb: ai-service refreshes it every 5 s while a turn runs (TTL 15 s); missing for 30 s → turn.failed
